title: Accounts & Finance Manager
description:
Looking for a Senior Accounting professional for a tech platform in Mumbai!
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Stakeholder Management
 



 o Act as the primary finance point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
 



 o Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment on
 



 financial processes and requirements.
 



 o Manage vendor, auditor, and consultant interactions with professionalism and timely responses.
 



  





 2\. Revenue Coordination
 



 o Oversee revenue recognition, billing processes, and reconciliation.
 



 o Ensure timely invoicing, follow\-up on collections, and address revenue leakages.
 



 o Coordinate with KAM and Ops team to validate revenue inputs and ensure accuracy in reporting.
 



  





 3\. Review of Books \& Financial Reporting
 



 o Review monthly books of accounts and ensure timely month\-end close.
 



 o Analyse financial statements and highlight variances, risks, and business insights.
 



 o Ensure accuracy in accounting entries in line with applicable standards.
 



  





 4\. Policy Development \& Process Improvement
 



 o Draft, review, and implement finance\-related policies, SOPs, and internal controls.
 



 o Drive process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
 



  





 5\. Audit (Internal \& Statutory)
 



 o Lead internal, statutory, and compliance audits end\-to\-end.
 



 o Provide necessary documentation, resolve queries, and ensure timely closure of audit issues.
 



 o Ensure audit\-readiness throughout the year.
 



  





 6\. Compliance \& Governance
 



 o Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, including GST, TDS, Income Tax, Companies Act, and other regulatory mandates.
 



 o Timely filing of returns, payments, and coordination with consultants.
 



 o Maintain strong governance and adherence to corporate policies.
 



  





 7\. Additional Responsibilities
 



 o Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
 



 o Assist management in decision\-making through data\-driven insights.
 



 o Handle multiple projects simultaneously and deliver within timelines.
 



  





**Job Qualifications** 




  





 o Inter CA/CA with 5\+ years of relevant experience. Any other similar PG is also considered.
 



 o Strong understanding of accounting standards, compliance, and audit requirements.
 



 o Excellent multitasking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 o Proficiency in Excel, financial systems, and automation tools.
 



 o Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with high ownership.
 



 o Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment, adapting to changing priorities and deadlines
 



 o Experience in the legal/financial services/insurance industry is preferred.
